bond.creditRisk: Giá bán có thể giảm do rủi ro tín dụng; mẫu hiện tại không mô phỏng vỡ nợ ngẫu nhiên.

SCENARIOS.label: Nhịp tăng trưởng
SCENARIOS.description: Tiêu dùng khởi sắc, doanh nghiệp có thêm cơ hội. Thị trường vẫn có thể đi ngược dự báo.

SCENARIOS.label: Thị trường thận trọng
SCENARIOS.description: Nhà đầu tư dè dặt hơn. Tài sản phòng thủ được chú ý, nhưng không có kết quả nào được đảm bảo.

SCENARIOS.label: Tín hiệu phục hồi
SCENARIOS.description: Niềm tin đang quay trở lại. Cơ hội xuất hiện cùng những biến động khó đoán.

policy.course: Non-cash-heavy only with >=2 remaining STARTs; same as old lap<=2 at H=3.
policy.business: Buy/upgrade before final lap; sell at business tile in final lap. No future RNG/price access.
policy.exitWindow: Separate sensitivity: buy/upgrade before penultimate lap; attempt sale at business tiles in last two laps; never reopen in exit window.
policy.cashCourse: Cash-only plus the same course policy; controls salary uplift when assessing business.
policy.savingsNoCourse: Same savings policy but never buys course; isolates saving returns against cash-heavy.
policy.savings: Same 40M initial term3, new lots at 85% excess cash, term=min(3, remaining STARTs); diversified 15M term1 and 25% excess.
policy.assets: Unchanged published ticket amounts, buying gates, fees and funding order; no discretionary START sales; business sells only at its own tile.
policy.goalVariants: Reclassify identical 4-lap terminal trajectories; total requirement = item price + unchanged 10M reserve. No goal-dependent strategy changes.

definitions.financialShocks: Personal financial event encounters only; macro and ordinary obligation tiles reported separately.
definitions.financialDecisions: All event choices/acknowledgments + voluntary trades/deposits/upgrades + funding actions; not all are meaningful alternatives.
definitions.first90: Earliest observed action boundary or post-settlement summary; temporary threshold crossing is not terminal victory.
definitions.businessRealizedProfit: For sold businesses: collected income + net resale - initial cost - upgrades. Unsold businesses have no completed-cycle realized P/L.
definitions.investmentProfit: Savings earned interest + bond coupons/redemption + net financial sales + terminal net financial quotes - financial asset purchases; excludes business/course.
definitions.accounting: Funds=50M+salary+bonus-living due-extraordinary due-course-interest+financial investment profit+business cash contribution; locked book value excluded.
